0.fields_text:
destination name: "Hangzhou (杭州), Zhejiang Province, China"
date: "August 10, 2026 (summer, peak lotus season)"
weather_summary: "Hot and humid with temperatures 28–35°C (highs), 23–27°C (lows). Mostly cloudy with afternoon thunderstorms. Frequent rain. Typhoon 'White Dolphin' passed through around Aug 5–9, bringing heavy rain relief. High humidity (80–95%). UV Index: Very high (10–11). Travel tip: Bring an umbrella AND sunscreen. Start outdoor activities before 11 AM to avoid afternoon storms."
hero_image_url: "https://www.ourchinastory.com/images/content/snapshot/2021/12/%E7%95%B玉%E4%B8%AD%E5%9C%8B-%E4%B8%AD%E5%9C%8B%E6%97%85%E9%81%8A-%E4%B8%AD%E5%9C%8B%E6%96%87%E5%8C%96-%E6%9D%AD%E5%B7%9E-%E8%A5%BF%E6%B9%96%E4%B8%89%E7%B5%95-03_x1.jpg"
trip_summary: "Experience the best of Hangzhou in one day: start your morning at the sacred Lingyin Temple surrounded by ancient stone carvings, spend the afternoon cycling along West Lake's poetic causeways past iconic sights like Broken Bridge and Leifeng Pagoda, and end your evening savoring authentic Hangzhou cuisine at a lakeside restaurant or exploring the vibrant Hefang Street night market."

1.items_text:
name: "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon (三潭印月)", image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Three_Pools_Mirroring_the_Moon-pool.JPG?width=800", short_description: "The most iconic of the 'Ten Scenes of West Lake' — the image printed on the back of China's 1 RMB banknote. Three stone pagodas rise from the water; the interplay of moonlight and reflections is magical.", estimated_visit_duration: "1–1.5 hours"

name: "Leifeng Pagoda (雷峰塔)", image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Leifeng_Pagoda.JPG?width=800", short_description: "Famous from the White Snake legend. Take the elevator to the top for panoramic views of the entire West Lake. Sunset here is legendary — golden light spills across the lake.", estimated_visit_duration: "1–1.5 hours"

name: "Broken Bridge (断桥残雪)", image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Bai_Causeway.jpg?width=800", short_description: "The legendary meeting place of the White Snake Lady and Xu Xian. Famous for winter snow scenes but photogenic year-round.", estimated_visit_duration: "30–40 minutes"

name: "Su Causeway (苏堤春晓)", image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Sudi_20230716_112957.jpg?width=800", short_description: "A 2.8km poetic causeway lined with weeping willows and peach blossoms in spring. Ideal for cycling or walking.", estimated_visit_duration: "1–2 hours (walking) / 30–40 min (cycling)"
